cards.front: exercise
cards.back: Moving your body to make it stronger, such as running or swimming.
cards.say: exercise. Moving your body to make it stronger, such as running or swimming.

cards.front: Why is exercise good for you?
cards.back: It makes your heart, lungs and muscles stronger.
cards.say: Why is exercise good for you? It makes your heart, lungs and muscles stronger.

cards.front: Name two kinds of exercise.
cards.back: Running and swimming. Cycling, dancing and football too.
cards.say: Name two kinds of exercise. Running and swimming. Cycling, dancing and football too.

cards.front: How much sleep do children usually need?
cards.back: About nine to eleven hours each night.
cards.say: How much sleep do children usually need? About nine to eleven hours each night.

cards.front: Why do we need sleep?
cards.back: Sleep lets the body rest and grow, and helps us think and learn.
cards.say: Why do we need sleep? Sleep lets the body rest and grow, and helps us think and learn.

cards.front: hygiene
cards.back: Keeping yourself and your surroundings clean so that you stay well.
cards.say: hygiene. Keeping yourself and your surroundings clean so that you stay well.

cards.front: Why do we wash our hands before eating?
cards.back: To remove germs that could make us ill.
cards.say: Why do we wash our hands before eating? To remove germs that could make us ill.

cards.front: When should you wash your hands?
cards.back: Before eating, after using the toilet and after playing outside.
cards.say: When should you wash your hands? Before eating, after using the toilet and after playing outside.

cards.front: How long should you wash your hands?
cards.back: About twenty seconds with soap and water.
cards.say: How long should you wash your hands? About twenty seconds with soap and water.

cards.front: Why do we brush our teeth?
cards.back: To remove food and keep teeth and gums healthy.
cards.say: Why do we brush our teeth? To remove food and keep teeth and gums healthy.

cards.front: How often should you brush your teeth?
cards.back: Twice a day, in the morning and at night.
cards.say: How often should you brush your teeth? Twice a day, in the morning and at night.

cards.front: Why should we drink water through the day?
cards.back: The body needs water to work well.
cards.say: Why should we drink water through the day? The body needs water to work well.

cards.front: Why do we cover our mouth when we cough?
cards.back: To stop germs from spreading to other people.
cards.say: Why do we cover our mouth when we cough? To stop germs from spreading to other people.

cards.front: True or false: Germs are too small to see without help.
cards.back: True. Many germs can only be seen with a microscope.
cards.say: True or false: Germs are too small to see without help. True. Many germs can only be seen with a microscope.

cards.front: Why should we use a tissue when we sneeze?
cards.back: It catches germs. Put it in the bin after use.
cards.say: Why should we use a tissue when we sneeze? It catches germs. Put it in the bin after use.

cards.front: Why is it good to spend time outdoors?
cards.back: We get fresh air, exercise and daylight.
cards.say: Why is it good to spend time outdoors? We get fresh air, exercise and daylight.

cards.front: Why do we wear sunscreen in strong sun?
cards.back: To protect the skin from sunburn.
cards.say: Why do we wear sunscreen in strong sun? To protect the skin from sunburn.

cards.front: Why do we eat meals at regular times?
cards.back: It gives the body steady energy through the day.
cards.say: Why do we eat meals at regular times? It gives the body steady energy through the day.

cards.front: How does a clean room help health?
cards.back: There is less dirt and fewer germs, so we are less likely to get ill.
cards.say: How does a clean room help health? There is less dirt and fewer germs, so we are less likely to get ill.

cards.front: What is a healthy snack?
cards.back: Fruit, vegetables or nuts, not sweets or crisps.
cards.say: What is a healthy snack? Fruit, vegetables or nuts, not sweets or crisps.

cards.front: Why do we have a bath or shower?
cards.back: To wash away sweat and dirt and keep our skin healthy.
cards.say: Why do we have a bath or shower? To wash away sweat and dirt and keep our skin healthy.

cards.front: What can happen if you do not sleep enough?
cards.back: You feel tired and find it hard to learn.
cards.say: What can happen if you do not sleep enough? You feel tired and find it hard to learn.

cards.front: Why should we keep our nails short and clean?
cards.back: Dirt and germs can hide under long nails.
cards.say: Why should we keep our nails short and clean? Dirt and germs can hide under long nails.
